card.description: A towering basalt obelisk, 30 m tall, etched with ancient Ethiopian‑Egyptian glyphs that glow with bioluminescent light, housing a crystalline core pulsing with energy. The shaft is weathered, dust‑laden, and integrated into a subterranean power grid of metal conduits and copper wiring. The scene is cinematic, photorealistic, and tactile, evoking industrial mysticism and grounded realism.
visual_anatomy: **Body/Form:** 30 m basalt shaft, tapering, carved panels, weathered surface, dust and soot accumulation.
**Face/Sensors:** Glyph panels with embedded crystal lenses, pulsing bioluminescent light, subtle holographic glyphs visible in low light.
**Key Features:** Central crystalline core, glowing glyphs, metal conduits, copper wiring, dust, soot, subtle shadows.
evolution: Phase 1 (Construction): Raw basalt shaft, no glyphs, minimal weathering.
Phase 2 (Activation): Glyphs illuminated, core glowing, conduits energized.
props: Item: Scepter of the High Priest – a bronze staff with a carved obsidian tip and etched hieroglyphs.
Item: Runic Data Disk – a silver disk with etched runes, emitting faint blue light.
